_comment: Manual quality scores on the Artificial Analysis coding-index scale, keyed by model family (scripts/rank.ts family()). Used only where the AA API gives no coding index for a model. Set from the 2026-10-11 review (independent agentic-coding benchmarks and a live pi eval), then multiplied by 1.7, the median ratio of AA's coding index to these seeds across the 14 families both covered on 2026-10-11, so seeded and AA-scored models compare fairly. Higher is better. Exception: laguna-s-2-1 is held at 45, below measured models, since its only scores are Poolside's own and it often hit upstream rate limits on Kilo (2026-10-11).
